items.title: Completeness for a larger ideal passes to any finitely generated subideal
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for ideals I contained in J with I finitely generated, every J-adically complete module is also I-adically complete (statement lines 22992-22997). The proof does not compare the two filtrations abstractly: it reduces to a principal ideal by the single-generator surjectivity criterion, uses J-adic completeness to find a limit, reduces to sequences lying deep in the J-adic filtration, and then exhibits each term as f^n times a convergent geometric-like series obtained from the telescoping relation (proof lines 22999-23020). Recognising the telescoping sum and proving its convergence is the substance, and the author writes the series out. H2.
